title: macOS packaged candidate rebuilt with Wave1 merges; visible-GUI journey blocked by host TCC grants

build.sidecar: vnext/packaging/build_backend.py via `uv run --extra dev --with pyinstaller` (the bare pyenv python lacked alembic and produced a dead binary on the first attempt — fixed and smoke-passed)
build.dmg: FAILED: bundle_dmg.sh error after the .app was bundled; .app is sufficient for the visible-GUI gate. Recovery: rerun `npm run tauri:build` or bundle dmg separately once Finder/AppleScript automation is available.

sidecar_from_packaged_app.note: the .app spawned its embedded backend-runtime sidecar successfully and it serves the updated contracts (run_state/turn_command include combat)

blocked.what: visible WebView window journey with screenshots
blocked.why: ZCode Computer Use helper lacks macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording TCC grants; get_app_state/list_windows/screenshot and `screencapture` CLI all fail (`could not create image from display`)
blocked.recovery_condition: In System Settings > Privacy & Security, grant Accessibility and Screen Recording to 'ZCode Computer Use.app', fully quit and reopen ZCode so the helper restarts, then relaunch DZMM.app and drive: model profile probe -> new run from world -> opening -> >=5 turns -> formal ending -> same-world new run, screenshotting each stage into eval/evidence/screens/phase196/.

not_claimed: macOS visible-GUI player journey remains UNVERIFIED in this run; do not count it toward the cutover gates.
